title: ARENA: Active Region attENtion Aggregation for interpretable solar flare prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.32758v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Predicting solar flares is a challenging space-weather forecasting problem with potentially significant impacts on Earth's upper atmosphere, including disruptions to radio communications. We propose Active Region attENtion Aggregation (ARENA), a neural network architecture that predicts solar flares from a variable number of active-region cutouts while learning to identify the region most relevant to the prediction. ARENA is trained using multiple-instance learning under weak supervision, requiring only a flare/no-flare label for the observation and no labels specifying the flare origin. The learned attention mechanism therefore provides a means of localizing the active region driving the prediction without explicit origin annotations. ARENA achieves a heidke skill score of 0.45 which is comparable to other flare prediction approaches. translated_title: ARENA：基于活动区注意力聚合的可解释太阳耀斑预报
translated_abstract: 预测太阳耀斑是一个具有挑战性的空间天气预报问题，其对地球高层大气可能产生重大影响，包括对无线电通信的干扰。我们提出了活动区注意力聚合（ARENA），这是一种神经网络架构，能够从数量可变的活动区切片中预测太阳耀斑，同时学习识别与预测最相关的区域。ARENA采用弱监督下的多示例学习进行训练，仅需观测对应的耀斑/无耀斑标签，无需标注耀斑起源位置。因此，学习到的注意力机制提供了一种无需显式起源标注即可定位驱动预测的活动区的方法。ARENA的Heidke技巧评分达到0.45，与其他耀斑预测方法相当。这些结果表明，基于活动区的聚合方法能够提供一种高效且可解释的替代方案。
tldr: ARENA是一种基于多示例学习的弱监督神经网络架构，通过注意力聚合机制从数量可变的活动区切片预测太阳耀斑，并能可解释地定位驱动预测的关键活动区，其Heidke技巧评分达0.45，与其他耀斑预测方法相当。
en_tdlr: ARENA is a neural network architecture trained with multiple-instance learning under weak supervision that predicts solar flares from a variable number of active-region cutouts while using learned attention to interpretably localize the most relevant region, achieving a Heidke skill score of 0.45 comparable to other flare prediction approaches.
